evidence_scope: Actual offline verification of public original SEC filing/header bytes in the local research cache; no licensed market source rows.

mac_discovery_inspection.original_sec_bytes_reread_note: The Mac inspector reread public manifest and six discovery-ledger fields; original SEC-byte corroboration ran separately in the local research workspace.

original_bytes_reread_location: local research workspace; not the Mac

independent_start_tag_scan.context_check_scope: For each referenced context ID, compare its independent source start-tag count with the frozen report context occurrence count; context values and XBRL semantics are not interpreted.
independent_start_tag_scan.input: Original bytes decoded one-to-one as Latin-1 in 1 MiB chunks for ASCII markup token comparison.

limitations: Counts characterize retained parser.error_log entries. Forty-one logs contain exactly 100 entries, so they may omit further conditions; zero retained FATAL or truncation messages does not establish their absence from all underlying parser behavior.

The independent tokenizer detects gross selected-start-tag loss and context-reference occurrence differences. It does not validate recovery reparenting, full text values, nested context semantics, taxonomy identity, continuations, transformations, CSS visibility, or all possible XBRL facts.
Hash equality binds the bytes actually checked to the frozen report and cache metadata; it does not independently prove the historical SEC document or delivery was complete.

Selected concept-name and contextRef comparison attributes were ASCII in this corpus. The independent Latin-1 scan is a byte-preserving markup diagnostic, not a document-character-encoding or XBRL value interpretation.

Malformed traditional HTML and duplicate general HTML IDs are retained diagnostic evidence. The successful lexical occurrence checks do not convert those documents into valid XML/XBRL or approved security identity evidence.

comcast_2020_dimensional_distinction.description: Both Comcast and NBCUniversal DEI CIK/name pairs are retained. The NBCUniversal fact context has dei:LegalEntityAxis / cmcsa:NBCUniversalMediaLLCMember while its entity identifier remains Comcast CIK 0001166691. No security or entity link is assigned from that context.

exchange_whitespace_only_additional_case.description: Exact parsed strings distinguish New York Stock Exchange with and without one trailing space. This gives 12 multiple-string exchange filings; a whitespace-collapsed diagnostic gives 11 without changing any retained value.

namespace_recognition_limitation.description: The frozen recognizer expects a date-shaped DEI URI and conservatively flags this year-only URI. The declaration, raw facts, and context bindings remain retained. No taxonomy validity or normalization is inferred.

retained_diagnostics.message_pattern_rule: Only the HTML ID token in duplicate-ID diagnostics is replaced by <HTML id> for grouped counts; exact message counts are retained separately.

scope.description: Read-only parser diagnostics and independent selected-start-tag checks on all original primary filing bodies bound to the frozen SEC identity evidence report.

parser_diagnostic_audit.original_bytes_reconstruction: Encode complete_report with Python json.dumps(indent=2, sort_keys=True), append one newline, then UTF-8 encode. This reproduces the pinned standalone audit bytes.
parser_diagnostic_audit.scope: Assistant inspection of retained parser diagnostics and independent selected-token occurrence counts; does not create a human review or XBRL validity approval.

postrun_reconciliation.scope: Read-only local reconciliation of the complete original-SEC evidence report, its gzip publication, the preserved manifest and the public Mac discovery report. No private ledger or original SEC bytes reread by this reconciliation.

publication.format: gzip-compressed complete JSON; empty gzip filename and mtime zero
